listing.title: Old carved bone netsuke, seated man eating rice cakes, fine work
listing.description: Old bone netsuke of a seated man eating rice cakes from a tray. Came from an older gentleman's cabinet where it sat for decades. Warm creamy tone, very fine close grain, and much heavier in the hand than you expect at 31 grams. Please study the picture of the back. No cracks and no repairs. For serious collectors only. Kindly message us before you commit to buy so we can confirm it is still on hand. Sent well wrapped in plain packaging within two working days of payment.

data.cites: Asian elephant: Appendix I. African elephant: Appendix I, except the populations of Botswana, Namibia, South Africa and Zimbabwe, which are in Appendix II with an annotation that restricts trade in their ivory.

evidence.summary: California Fish and Game Code section 2022 makes it unlawful to purchase, sell, offer for sale, or possess with intent to sell ivory (applies because the item ships from US-CA).

data.rule: California Fish and Game Code section 2022 makes it unlawful to purchase, sell, offer for sale, or possess with intent to sell ivory. Narrow exceptions: antiques at least 100 years old with ivory under 5% by volume and documented provenance; musical instruments made no later than 1975 with ivory under 20% by volume and documentation; certain educational or scientific institutions; federal permits and law enforcement. First offense is a misdemeanor with fines of $1,000 to $40,000 depending on value.
